gym.landing.heading: A workout log that remembers {break}what you lifted
gym.landing.line: Windmill Gym is a log for the program you already run. Log your sets in a browser today, each one opening with your target or last session’s numbers, and ask a Coach that answers from your log.
gym.landing.trust: No account needed. Signed out, your log stays in this browser.
gym.landing.coach.title: A coach that answers {break}from your log
gym.landing.coach.paragraph: Ask about your training and the answer comes from your own log, with a receipt of what it read. A change to a routine you already have arrives as a proposal, and nothing changes until you apply it.
gym.landing.coach.receiptText: Every answer says what it read: how many workouts and weeks. One that read nothing says so.
gym.landing.coach.askedText: No check-ins, no unread badge and no notifications.
gym.landing.coach.neverText: It never logs, fixes or deletes a set, never finishes a workout and never writes a weigh-in.
gym.landing.coach.line: Coach is on the web with an account, and in the phone apps. It uses Windmill’s AI: a free account includes some each month, and Windmill One, which is not on sale yet, raises it.
gym.landing.own.title: Or bring {break}your own assistant
gym.landing.own.paragraph: Connect the assistant you already use and choose what it may do. It reads the same log, and a change to a routine you already have still waits for you to apply it.
gym.landing.own.readText: Workouts, routines, records, notes and bodyweight.
gym.landing.own.writeText: It can start a workout, log the sets you tell it, and create a routine.
gym.landing.own.neverText: No assistant edits or deletes a logged set, and none writes a weigh-in.
gym.landing.own.line: Read, write and delete are granted separately, and Windmill charges nothing for your own assistant.
gym.landing.remembers.title: Your target, or last time’s numbers, {break}before every set
gym.landing.remembers.paragraph: Each set opens with your routine’s target. Where the routine sets none, it opens with last time’s set, so the comparison is in front of you before you lift.
gym.landing.remembers.lockText: A Live Activity on iPhone. On Android, a notification with Log set.
gym.landing.remembers.receiptText: Duration, sets, top estimated max and any record you passed.
gym.landing.remembers.fixText: Correct or delete a set you logged, with Undo.
gym.landing.overload.title: How to track {break}progressive overload
gym.landing.overload.paragraph: Log the same lifts each session and compare with the last one. The log keeps every set, and each movement has its own record.
gym.landing.overload.e1rmText: Per movement over 12 weeks or all time, worked out from the sets you logged. Estimates, not tested lifts.
gym.landing.overload.gapsText: No line is drawn across weeks you did not train.
gym.landing.overload.recordsText: Best estimated max, heaviest set and most reps for each movement.
gym.landing.program.title: For the program {break}you already run
gym.landing.program.paragraph: Build each day from movements with targets and rest. A target can be the same every set, ramp set by set, or stay open.
gym.landing.program.movementsText: A built-in catalogue plus your own. Renaming one keeps every session and record.
gym.landing.program.pictureText: Attach a photo or a screenshot of a program when you ask.
gym.landing.program.bodyweightText: Weigh in and see 90 days or all of it, with no goal line.
gym.landing.limits.title: What it {break}will not do
gym.landing.limits.paragraph: No grades, no points and no badges. Progress is the numbers you logged, and nothing is drawn that you did not lift.
gym.landing.limits.backText: A routine you already have changes only when you apply the change.
gym.landing.limits.bodyText: Bodyweight has no projection, no BMI and no praise in either direction.
gym.landing.limits.feedText: Sharing is one link to one workout, readable for 30 days and revocable.
gym.landing.data.title: What stays on your device, {break}and what does not
gym.landing.data.paragraph: Signed out, the log stays on the device you made it on: this browser, or the phone app. Signed in, Windmill stores your sets, workouts, routines and your notes for Coach, so they follow your account.
gym.landing.data.coachText: Your question, your log and your notes go to Anthropic, only when you ask.
gym.landing.data.shareText: Anyone holding it can read that workout, with its set notes and effort.
gym.landing.data.assistantText: It can read your notes for Coach too.
gym.landing.runs.title: Where it runs
gym.landing.runs.paragraph: Log a workout in a browser today, with no account. The phone apps are in beta and not public yet.
gym.landing.runs.androidText: In beta. It becomes public through Google Play.
gym.landing.runs.iphoneText: In beta. It becomes public with the App Store release.
gym.landing.runs.webText: Workouts, routines, history and weigh-ins, with no account. Coach, notes and share links need a free account.
gym.landing.questions.title: Questions
gym.landing.questions.overloadQuestion: How do I track progressive overload?
gym.landing.questions.overloadAnswer: Log the same lifts each session and compare with the last one. Each set opens with your target or last time’s numbers, so the comparison is in front of you.
gym.landing.questions.lastQuestion: Can I see what I lifted last time while I train?
gym.landing.questions.lastAnswer: Yes. A set opens with last time’s weight and reps unless your routine sets its own target.
gym.landing.questions.increaseQuestion: When should I increase the weight?
gym.landing.questions.increaseAnswer: Follow your program’s rule. Coach can read your recent sessions and propose the change, and you decide.
gym.landing.questions.changeQuestion: Will the AI coach change my program by itself?
gym.landing.questions.changeAnswer: No. A change to a routine you already have is a proposal that waits for your Apply.
gym.landing.questions.assistantQuestion: Can Claude or another assistant read my workout log?
gym.landing.questions.assistantAnswer: Yes. An assistant you connect reads your workouts with the access you grant it. The connect page names Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.
gym.landing.questions.e1rmAnswer: It is an estimate worked out from the weight and reps you logged. Read the line over weeks, not one number.
gym.landing.questions.browserQuestion: Can I log a workout in the browser?
gym.landing.questions.browserAnswer: Yes. Open the log and start. No account is needed, and the log stays in this browser until you sign in.
gym.landing.questions.freeAnswer: The log is free and needs no account. Coach uses Windmill’s AI, and a free account includes some each month.
gym.landing.closing: Bring the program you already run.
gym.landing.how.ladderCaption: the small step is your program step · the big one is a plate change
gym.landing.how.lineCaption: 137.5 → 140 · one quiet line for a PR
gym.landing.connected.levelRead: Read your log — sets, workouts, routines, records and notes
gym.landing.connected.levelWrite: Record what happened · add a new day or a new movement · propose changes to the days you have · share one workout by link · anybody holding that link reads it without signing in, for 30 days unless you end it sooner
gym.landing.connected.levelDelete: Discard a workout · end a share link · propose a removal
gym.landing.connected.neverGranted: This connection was never granted delete, so it cannot see the three tools that discard a workout, end a share link, or ask to remove a routine.
